g.text: Counter Store Data Model: One Key Per Client, Sharded by client_id
No relational schema -- the store IS the key/value model
TTL: a few refill-cycles worth -- long enough an active
client never expires mid-use, short enough an idle one frees memory.
Adding a shard only reshuffles the keys nearest it on
the ring -- not every client, the same guarantee this
guide's Consistent Hashing page makes generally.
